summary: Produced Robotis Lab initial system instructions and 24-week research roadmap (downloadable zip), covering 25 cm humanoid with 10 leg DOF, Webots simulation-first, Arduino Uno + PCA9685 low-level control, PC host for optional AI, independent safety, staged physical prototype under an aspirational 3m VND budget.
